verdict.rationale: BigCommerce's own docs say its REST and GraphQL APIs manage orders programmatically, and it documents a webhooks capability, including Google Cloud Pub/Sub webhooks. That covers the core of agent-driven order handling, but the evidence names no order-status, fulfillment/shipment or returns endpoints, and no order-event webhook topics. A secondhand community comment about API throttling is too vague to create a dispute and only lowers confidence. Missing for 10: documented fulfillment/shipment API, documented returns/refunds API, order status-transition endpoints, order-event webhook topic list, independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can take an order through its post-purchase lifecycle — status, fulfillment, returns — via documented APIs and webhooks without a human in the admin
